protocol: Preregistered read-only analysis of the authorized two-sweep chi5120 probe, global24 to26. Wait for sealed completed output and sync only JSON/NPZ provenance before running this existing workflow; missing outputs are not evidence of completion. Preserve all earlier analyses and compare the same labelled Hamiltonian, physical torus, cuts and three-site ROW joint-spin partitions. Compare chi4096/sweep24 with each chi5120 boundary, and sweep25 with26, using raw RDM trace/invariant-algebra distances, energy, discarded weight and unchanged physical scalars. Primary physical readout: compact6 signed P_perp(qL=3,qR=3,qT=0); companion control: connected three-bridge Y cumulant. Winding6 and conditional elementary-triangle E2/A2 are declared secondary quality diagnostics; do not select the largest contrast after inspection. Raw six-body, connected cumulants and conditional internal resonance are distinct quantities. Refinement drift is empirical, not a certified bias bound or MC SE. No new training,sampling,ED,MPS/H/H2 contractions or symmetry repair. This analysis neither identifies a second phase nor automatically releases the optional final two sweeps; inspect each quality trend first.
